## Context / Problem

A gate (`review-plan`, `verify-completion`) reads its `[tool.rebar.llm]` model config from the attested snapshot root (`origin/main`), by design since bug 2876 (`src/rebar/llm/config_readers.py:46-56`), but executes the locally installed rebar code. When `main` changes models in a way that needs matching code, every worktree still on the older code fails its gates.

Observed 2026-11-09 19:32 PST: commit `06b3b1a5230` ("Move configured models to the 5.5 generation") moved the config to `bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5` and, in the same commit, added the `_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES` rows that stop sending `temperature` to 5.5 models. `rebar review-plan maize-guilty-hapuku`, run from a worktree at `49f5d6d0580` (the parent of `06b3b1a5230`), returned `INDETERMINATE` with `llm_ran: false`: Bedrock rejected `temperature` with a 400 ValidationException. The same review after `git merge --ff-only origin/main` plus `make install` ran the model normally (19:42 PST).

Effects:
- The verdict is an unsigned `INDETERMINATE` with no finding naming the cause; the reason is only in `coverage.llm_error`.
- That error suggests editing `_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES` or unsetting temperature, though the fix already exists on `main` and the real remedy is updating the local install.

## Expected

A gate run whose attested config is newer than the executing code either detects the skew and says so (naming the attested SHA, the local code version, and the remedy: update the worktree and `make install`), or resolves model capabilities consistently with the config it read.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A gate run whose attested `[tool.rebar.llm]` config names a model the local code cannot drive reports the version skew and the update remedy, instead of only a provider 400 in `coverage.llm_error`; pinned by a test that pairs a newer attested config with older capability tables.
compiled_state.title: Gates read model config from origin/main but run local code, so stale worktrees fail
